overview: Oobah Butler sets his sights on the world’s biggest industries and most powerful institutions. To infiltrate the worlds of wine, wellness, royalty, and more, Oobah hatches elaborate and increasingly audacious schemes by gaming online reviews, assuming made-up personas, and launching fake companies with entirely bogus backstories.
tagline: Exposing the truth, one scam at a time.
